description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kumbaloluwa, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510260 (24/1102)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and addresses, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
